name: Internal IT Support
description: Task categories for classifying internal company IT support requests by the task pursued in the current conversation branch.
classification_guidance: Classify the task pursued by the current turn using the current turn and relevant branch context.
If the user switches to a different task, assign the category for the new task rather than carrying forward the previous branch category.
Choose one category that best represents the task. Use other_unclear_multi_intent only when no category is a defensible fit, the request is unclear, or unrelated tasks cannot be separated.
Task category is independent of Jev eligibility. Do not infer jev_eligible from the category alone.

categories.name: app_access_req
categories.description: Request to gain access to an application, system, repository, or service.
examples: I need access to Salesforce.
Can you add me to GitHub?

categories.name: group_role_perms
categories.description: Change an existing user's role, group membership, privilege, or permission level.
examples: Add me to the finance-admin group.
Change my role to project editor.

categories.name: account_pw
categories.description: Reset credentials or unlock an account that is locked out.
examples: I forgot my password.
Please unlock my account.

categories.name: mfa_sso_auth
categories.description: Multi-factor authentication enrollment or recovery, single sign-on, or authentication failures not primarily a password reset or unlock.
examples: I lost my MFA device.
Single sign-on keeps failing.

categories.name: app_issues
categories.description: Diagnose or resolve an application error, outage, malfunction, or broken feature.
examples: The expense app crashes when I submit a report.
The CRM returns an error when I save.

categories.name: sw_install_config_license
categories.description: Install, configure, update, or obtain a license for software.
examples: Can you install Docker Desktop?
I need a license for Adobe Acrobat.

categories.name: email_cal
categories.description: Email delivery, mailbox settings, calendar behavior, or calendar delegation and sharing.
examples: My emails are not arriving.
Give my assistant access to my calendar.

categories.name: collab_msgs
categories.description: Messaging, channels, meetings, chat, or collaboration-platform issues.
examples: Add me to the incident-response Slack channel.
Teams calls have no audio.

categories.name: sharing_files
categories.description: Shared drives, cloud storage, document permissions, and file-sharing behavior.
examples: I cannot open the shared folder.
How do I share this file externally?

categories.name: onboarding
categories.description: Provision accounts, applications, equipment, or access for an incoming employee or contractor.
examples: A new engineer starts Monday; provision their accounts.
Set up a laptop and access for our new hire.

categories.name: offboarding
categories.description: Deprovision access, disable accounts, recover equipment, or perform IT tasks for a departing employee or contractor.
examples: Disable an employee's accounts after their last day.
Revoke the departing contractor's access.

categories.name: dev_prov
categories.description: Request, prepare, replace, or reassign an endpoint or other company device.
examples: I need a new laptop.
Please replace my damaged company phone.

categories.name: endpoint_os_mdm
categories.desc: Endpoint, operating system, and device management
categories.description: Endpoint operating-system problems, device enrollment, management policies, or compliance state.
examples: My laptop will not install the required OS update.
My device is not appearing in MDM.

categories.name: hardware_peripheral
categories.description: Physical device faults or requests involving monitors, docks, printers, keyboards, and other peripherals.
examples: My monitor flickers.
The office printer is jammed.

categories.name: nw_vpn
categories.description: Network access, Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, connectivity, or related infrastructure reachability issues.
examples: I cannot connect to the corporate VPN.
The internal site is unreachable on office Wi-Fi.

categories.name: sec_ops
categories.description: Security incident or control requests, credential or secret rotation, and physical badge access.
examples: Rotate the API key for this service.
My building badge no longer works.

categories.name: data
categories.description: Restore deleted or corrupted data, recover files, or resolve backup and restoration issues.
examples: I accidentally deleted a shared folder; can it be restored?
Last night's backup failed.

categories.name: how_to
categories.description: A request for instructions or information about how to use an IT service, tool, or standard process, without asking for a state change or fault repair.
examples: How do I configure my email signature?
Where can I find the VPN setup guide?

categories.name: tkt_status
categories.description: Ask for status, ownership, an ETA, or follow-up on an existing support ticket or request.
examples: What is the status of ticket INC12345?
Has anyone picked up my access request?

categories.name: other
categories.description: Use only when the request does not fit another category, lacks enough information to identify a task, or combines unrelated tasks that cannot reasonably be assigned a single primary category.
examples: Can someone help me with something?
I need a laptop fixed and a payroll question answered.
